archetype: Mardu Vampire midrange with an aristocrat engine: eminence mints bodies, six free outlets turn them into counters, drains and mana, and big lifelink flyers close. The frame calls it lords-and-payoffs; the list agrees, but still carries flat static pumps the pilot has ruled out.
verdict: It develops: a castable Vampire is drawn in 95.3% of goldfish games and the turn-3 land drop lands at 0.917. On standard-v3 this list read 48/155 (0.31), 40/176 (0.227) and 48/171 (0.281) across one 200-game run and the two arms of the 2026-10-03 A/A, pooled 136/502 = 0.271; the table's 0.233 null is plain-harness and is not compared. What limits it is input AND refuel, and neither is ranked above the other: ramp is 8 against 10 and black 32 against 36, the pilot reports running out of both cards and mana at T7/T8, and no Forge arm has isolated either.

gaps: Death-triggered draw is still unmodelled by the goldfish: meta.card_advantage lists Skullclamp, Liliana, Crossway Troublemakers, Midgar and six more in draw_not_modelled. Every extra-cards row above is a floor.

The two Forge arms touching death draw do not isolate it. drain-v1 added one death-draw card (Species Specialist) plus Twilight Prophet, Bastion of Remembrance, Malakir Bloodwitch, Toxic Deluge and Vein Ripper, and cut Bloodthirsty Conqueror, Cordial Vampire, Blade of the Bloodchief, Bloodflow Connoisseur, Legion Lieutenant and Stromkirk Captain: empty-hand turns +0.05 [−0.18, +0.28], extra draw −0.062 [−0.19, +0.06]. draw-v1 added four draw cards (Dark Prophecy, Morbid Opportunist, Midnight Reaper, Ajani) but cut three death-makers (Vish Kal, Altar of Dementia, Bloodflow Connoisseur) and The Haunt: empty-hand turns −0.057 [−0.30, +0.19], extra draw +0.066 [−0.06, +0.19]. The A/A arms read 0.73 and 0.67 empty-hand turns on one list, so both nulls sit inside that noise and neither excludes a large effect.

Forge and the log disagree on refuel. The champion ends a median of 0 own turns empty-handed (mean 0.72, ci95 [0.55, 0.90], 200 games) and draws 1.41–1.46 extra cards per own turn. Round-2 finding partly fixed: 'the axis that binds' is gone, the false Banner claim is gone, and Edgar's median cast turn of 6 and 0.597 by T6 match goldfish_metrics.metrics. But the evidence is mislabelled. 'The one mana-only swap screened, Legion Lieutenant for Talisman of Hierarchy' is not mana-only: it cuts a two-drop Vampire, which is a body and an eminence trigger. The goldfish does not read static lords at all. In goldfish_turn.py, team_anthem is fed only by team_counters_etb and team_counters_scale_type. Legion Lieutenant -> Vampire Interloper screens damage @T10 +0.022 [+0.016, +0.029] and board @T6 +0.021, so dropping the lord costs nothing in the model. The -0.281 is a body lost, not mana failing to pay. Conversely, Patchwork Banner -> Mind Stone screens +0.063 [+0.045, +0.081], so Banner's anthem is invisible too, and Banner -> Rakdos Signet (+0.236, better on 7 of 10 rows including extra cards +0.044) IS the mana-only screen in the model. That swap is cheaper and coloured, and it reads better. The section cited here (strategy:conversion.raising-the-ceiling) asks to 'hold the 99 fixed and ask what the deck does with two more mana'. Neither screen does that. 'Under target, not shown to bind' can stand, but cite the right screen and label the Talisman one as body-for-rock.

The claim 'The goldfish still values the pump; the pilot's rule overrides it' is false on the model. The static '+1/+1 to other Vampires' is not read (see axes[4]): Legion Lieutenant -> Vampire Interloper screens +0.022 [+0.016, +0.029], better. What the goldfish values in this slot is a cheap Vampire cast, not the pump. That matters for open_questions[2], whose two candidate fills (Phyrexian Arena, a black-source card) are both non-Vampires. The screens agree: Arena -0.414 and Talisman -0.281 reproduce exactly, and a two-drop Vampire is neutral to positive. The pilot's no-flat-anthem rule and the measurement point the same way: replace the lord with a Vampire that multiplies or draws. Difficulty 'contested' is fair. Leaving the slot open rather than filling it is correct under the no-filler rule.

The claim 'The pump alone screens damage @T10 -0.513 (swapped for Smothering Tithe)' is mislabelled. Tithe is invisible, so that figure is the loss of a three-drop Vampire's body and eminence trigger. The pump is unread: Stromkirk Captain -> Vampire Interloper screens +0.070 [+0.054, +0.085]. The conclusion stands: the BMC pair reads +0.108 [+0.093, +0.123], reproduced, and team first strike is the unpriced cost. Re-label the -0.513 as body plus eminence. Difficulty 'painful' and the first-strike enumeration still hold.

The claim 'the screen moves the anthem and the mana together, so it is not a mana-only measurement' is false for the goldfish, which does not read Patchwork Banner's static anthem. Banner -> Mind Stone is +0.063 [+0.045, +0.081], not a loss. In the model the Signet screen is a pure mana-efficiency and colour swap. The figures reproduce: +0.236 [+0.208, +0.265], board +0.290, better on 7 of 10 rows, W +2 -> +1. Provenance (edhrec_cards.json, absent from pool.txt) checks out.
